limitations: Rankings are candidate associations, not satellite identifications.
The site preset is reviewed but not capture-bound GPS authority.
Antenna boresight and gain pattern are unknown.
PSS and GLRT may observe different simultaneous transmitters or beams.
PSS absolute UTC frame cycle is unresolved when start-time uncertainty exceeds one frame.
GLRT physical IQ/mixer sign is not independently calibrated; opposite-sign results are controls.
No SSS, payload, known-pilot, or beam schedule evidence is used.

method.catalogue_filter: latest raw TLE snapshot collected before capture; element epoch no later than first sample; usable, plausible altitude, above geometric horizon
method.glrt_anchor_sensitivity: repeat each receiver ranking on its single largest Hough episode, without global episode stitching; integer alias class is absorbed only by the declared constant CFO nuisance
method.glrt_dual_receiver_consensus: primary GLRT consensus is the equal-weight mean of squared per-receiver normalized holdout RMS ratios; per-receiver rankings remain explicit
method.glrt_model: GLRT-only integer-alias-stitched canonical CFO = physical TLE Doppler + constant receiver/LNB CFO offset
method.holdout: fit nuisance on first 60% and predict last 40%, then reverse; ranking uses quadratic mean of the two RMS values
method.primary_joint_score: squared normalized PSS holdout RMS ratio plus the equal-weight mean of squared physical-sign GLRT ratios across both receivers
method.pss_model: observed unwrapped arrival phase = geometric range/c + constant clock offset + constant clock drift*time
